R1957.summary: Frederick II to his secretary Louis Michell in London: he agrees that the King of Sardinia will join the Austro-Spanish treaty, has learned that Vienna and St Petersburg plan to make Prince Charles of Lorraine King of Poland, and asks Michell to find out what London knows, how long the English ministry's pacific system will last, and to report to the King alone. The text is printed from the minute in the Politische Correspondenz, vol. 8 (1882), no. 5263.

system: Frederick II's cabinet code of 1751 to Michell: a numerical nomenclator, point-separated groups 2-6472, with homophones for common words, separate groups for endings and phrase groups.
